shorts.hook: Scientists still can't find the bottom of this blue hole.
shorts.title: This Blue Hole Is So Deep the Cable Ran Out First
shorts.outro: The next discovery is even deeper. The full dive is linked below.
shorts.description: In 2023 scientists lowered an instrument 420 meters into Mexico's Taam Ja' blue hole without touching the bottom, and Doug goes to find it himself.

shorts.hook: In 1997, the ocean made a sound louder than a blue whale.
shorts.title: The Ocean's Loudest Mystery Sound Turned Out to Be Ice
shorts.outro: It only gets worse from here. The full dive is linked below.
shorts.description: The 1997 Bloop was louder than a blue whale and turned out to be cracking icebergs, but the Upsweep, recorded since 1991, is still unexplained.

shorts.hook: Scientists named this underwater lake the Jacuzzi of Despair.
shorts.title: This Underwater Lake Kills and Preserves Whatever Falls In
shorts.outro: What happens next is even worse. The full dive is linked below.
shorts.description: A brine pool 1,000 meters down in the Gulf of Mexico has no oxygen, kills crabs that cross its rim and preserves them in salt, and Doug thinks it's a hot tub.
